extracted.intended_audience: journalists; public relations professionals; public subscribers; experts at research institutions
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and service-description for organizations and communications professionals who want to post and distribute press releases through the Newswise newswire, including required registration, wire selection, accepted content types, topical categorization, and distribution/archiving behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration and account role selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Register as a journalist, a media relations professional, or a public user, and select your preferred wire subscription.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must create an account and choose their role (journalist / media relations professional / public user) before participating; role selection determines available services (e.g., posting releases vs. receiving embargoed content).

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted content types
rubrics_metrics.description: The majority of news releases posted to Newswise include embargoed research results, feature stories, and expert pitches. Newswise members may also contribute announcements, press conference notices, product news and announcements, and up-front media pitches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should fall into these accepted categories; content outside these types may not align with Newswise's primary feeds. Use appropriate content type when posting so it is routed to the right wire and audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargoed research handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalists can find embargoed research news; the majority of news releases posted include embargoed research results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Newswise supports embargoed research distribution — submitters should indicate embargo status and timings so journalists can use embargoed material appropriately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wire selection and frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: Newswise Wires are available daily, or semi-weekly. Examples: Daily Wire, MedWire, SciWire, LifeWire, BizWire.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When registering/posting, select the wire(s) most appropriate for your content and the desired delivery frequency; different wires target different topical audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical categorization
rubrics_metrics.description: Each Newswise article is categorized into Medical, Science, Life, or Business News.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the correct topical category for your release so it is delivered to the appropriate subscriber lists and appears in the correct channel pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution reach
rubrics_metrics.description: Articles are delivered to more than 20,000 subscribers through the Newswise Wires; PR professionals can reach thousands of users through the Newswise website and email wires.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this distribution metric as an expected-reach guideline when deciding whether to post to Newswise and which wire/category to choose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permanent archiving
rubrics_metrics.description: Each news release is also permanently archived on the website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content posted to Newswise remains permanently available on the site; consider long-term implications of published content and disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience-specific value for journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalists can find embargoed research news, expert sources, and feature ideas to help them do their jobs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing releases aimed at journalists, highlight embargo details, provide expert contacts, and present story/feature hooks to increase pick-up likelihood.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience-specific value for PR professionals
rubrics_metrics.description: Public relations professionals post and distribute their news releases, reaching thousands of users through the Newswise website and email wires.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PR practitioners should use the platform to broaden distribution and target appropriate wires; membership enables posting and wire delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience-specific features for public subscribers
rubrics_metrics.description: Public subscribers can share articles in social media platforms and start discussions in the comment sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If aiming for public engagement, craft releases to encourage sharing and conversation; public users have social-sharing and commenting capabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expert services and discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: Newswise provides Expert Pitch, Expert Query, and an Expert Directory to find experts available to comment on breaking news and to request expert contacts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Expert Pitch/Directory services to connect releases with available experts or to solicit expert commentary; request responses directly to an inbox via Expert Query.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership / participating institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Newswise members are innovative, influential organizations world-wide, including top medical schools, universities, research institutions, public relations firms, government agencies, non-profit organizations, associations and advocacy groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizations of these types are typical and expected participants; membership is the pathway for posting and accessing member services.
